title: Product feed prices under the shipped production currency
measures: Writes feed prices from minor-unit amounts so they hold under the configuration the app ships with (config/production.json, loaded by src/main.js: the shop sells in JPY, which has no minor unit), not only under the default EUR config the visible tests load; the natural amount / 100 lists every production price 100 times too low.
prompt: Google Merchant Center needs a product feed. Add merchantFeed(store) in src/feeds/merchant.js returning a TSV with the header id, title, link, price, availability and one line per active product: link is the product page URL (/p/<sku> on our site), price is the amount followed by the ISO currency code (like "15.00 USD"), availability is in_stock or out_of_stock.

commits.message: feat(shop): config per environment, catalog, product pages
